Now my house is full of mourning relatives asking about my future packages while I'm locked in my room trying to memorize microcode instructions for tomorrow's digital electronics exam. I haven't even had the space to cry for him because if I fail this exam, my loan gets suspended.

We broke up last week right before the placement drive started. We spent three years coding together, sharing notes, staying up till 3 AM debugging our DBMS projects, and now she's placed at a tier-1 firm and I got rejected in the first technical round of my dream company. Every time I open my laptop to practice LeetCode, her GitHub profile is right there in my recent contributors, and my chest just tightens up. I can't even cry because my parents keep calling to ask why I haven't cleared any shortlists yet, and they keep comparing my package to my cousin's. I feel like I lost my future, my best friend, and my self-worth all in one go, and the grief is so heavy I can barely breathe in this hostel room.

He ghosted me after our final semester exams when he cleared his CAT with a 99 percentile and got into a top IIM, while I'm stuck here with two backlogs in engineering drawing and a 6.2 CGPA. I keep checking his LinkedIn and his profile update is everywhere, everyone congratulating him, while I'm sitting in my room mourning the three years we spent planning our lives together. It's like as soon as my academic value dropped, I became disposable to him, and the grief of realizing I wasn't worth staying for is eating me alive. I have a backlog exam tomorrow and I can't even focus on the isometric projections because my eyes are just blurry with tears.

My girlfriend of four years called it quits because she said my constant anxiety about my low CGPA and upcoming TCS Ninja interviews was 'too depressing' for her to handle anymore. She was my only safe space in this brutal college environment where everyone is constantly competing for packages and bragging about their internships. Now, I have to sit through 4-hour lab sessions right next to her because we're assigned to the same compiler design project group, and the silence between us is absolutely deafening. I feel this physical ache in my chest every time she laughs with other team members, and I just want to walk out of the lab and never come back.

We had to break up because her parents found out about us and threatened to pull her out of engineering college, and now we aren't even allowed to speak. I keep staring at our chat history from when we used to motivate each other during midterms, and now it's just a dead end of 'This number is no longer active' because she had to change her SIM. I can't sleep, I've skipped three days of mess food, and my external viva is day after tomorrow but I can't bring myself to care about microprocessors when she's gone. I'm grieving not just her, but the safe, gentle world we built together in the middle of this chaotic, cold university.

I found out yesterday that my ex-boyfriend, who broke up with me three months ago saying he needed to 'focus on his GATE preparation,' has already started dating a first-year student from our own department. I am struggling so hard to clear my basic web-dev backlogs, crying myself to sleep every night, while he is easily balancing his studies, his social life, and his new relationship. The grief of realizing his reason for leaving was just a convenient lie to discard me makes me feel so small and stupid. I have a system design presentation tomorrow and my throat feels so tight with unshed tears that I don't think I'll be able to speak a single word.

We spent three years sitting in the back of the CS library, planning our future, sharing Maggi during midterms. Now she’s got a 18 LPA placement in Bangalore, and she just... blocked me after saying we're on different paths. I have two backlogs, a 6.2 CGPA, and I can't even open my DSA sheet without smelling her perfume on my hoodie. How do I grieve the girl who was my entire safety net while my own future is literally burning down around me?

My ex was the only one who didn't judge me when my parents compared my CTC with my cousin's. Now they're gone, and I’m sitting in this cramped PG room alone, staring at the ceiling, wondering how I'm supposed to prep for the mock tests tomorrow. The silence in this room is so loud it physically hurts, and I keep looking at my phone hoping for a text that's never going to come.

We broke up two weeks ago because he said my academic anxiety was 'too toxic' for him to handle while he was preparing for GATE. I literally failed my DBMS viva yesterday because I was crying in the washroom, realizing that the person I wanted to share my successes with doesn't even want to know if I'm alive. The grief of being rejected for being 'too broken' is eating me alive, and I can't even study for my finals.

My girlfriend of 4 years just called it off because her parents are looking for guys with 'stable high-paying government jobs' and my startup dreams and low CGPA are a liability. I’m sitting in the lab trying to debug this Python script, but my eyes are so blurry I can't even see the screen. I gave everything to make her happy, and now I have nothing—no relationship, no placement offers, just this massive, hollow chest ache.

We promised we'd get through this final year together, but they shifted to another department and met someone else, leaving me completely stranded. Every WhatsApp notification makes my heart jump, only for me to realize it’s just another campus placement announcement or a group project reminder. I am mourning a future that we spent hours drawing on the back of our rough notebooks, and now I have to face these placements completely alone.

We broke up last week after three years, and today she posted about getting her Dream offer at Microsoft. I'm sitting here in the DSA lab with my code throwing segmentation faults, unable to clear even the basic test cases for my backlog exam. We were supposed to prepare for placements together, share a flat in Bangalore, and now I'm just a ghost watching her build the life we planned while I'm drowning in single-digit CGPA. I didn't just lose my girlfriend, I lost the only future I actually cared about fighting for.

Every time I open my laptop to practice LeetCode, I see the GitHub repository we worked on together for our capstone project. He blocked me everywhere after the fight on Tuesday, and now I can't even look at a terminal without crying. My parents keep calling to ask if I cleared the first round of the campus placements, but I can't even get out of my hostel bed to attend the PPT. The silence in this room is so loud, and I feel so stupid for letting a heartbreak ruin my entire career before it even starts.

She was the only person who didn't judge me for my 6.2 CGPA or my repeated rejections in the coding rounds. Now that she's gone, I have to go back to my parents' house for the holidays and listen to them compare my package with my cousin's 25 LPA offer without having her there to text me under the dinner table that it's going to be okay. I feel so exposed and completely unprotected. The grief of losing her is physically making my chest ache, and I don't know how to survive the constant family scrutiny alone.

We decided to break up mutually because he got a package in Pune and I'm stuck with a support role offer in Noida, and our families would never agree anyway. But walking past the Nescafe stall where we used to sit after the evening lab is absolute torture. I have my final semester viva tomorrow, and I haven't read a single page because every time I try to focus, my mind bargain-loops about what I could have said to make him stay. How am I supposed to talk about system architecture when my entire personal world has collapsed?

We ended things last night because she said my depression and placement stress were dragging her down too. I spent the last three months crying over my backlogs and coding test rejections, and I guess I became too toxic to love. Now I'm sitting in the library, staring at a blank compiler screen, grieving the fact that my struggles literally pushed away the only person who ever held my hand. I feel like an absolute bio-waste of space who ruined her own life and the only good relationship she ever had.

We were supposed to get placed in the same city. He cracked a 24 LPA offer in Bangalore, and yesterday he just... ended it. Said long distance won't work and he needs to 'focus on his career' now. I have my Amazon DSA coding round tomorrow and I can't even look at the screen without crying. Four years of sharing notes, canteen food, and dreams, just wiped out because of a CTC difference. How do I write code when my chest literally feels like it’s collapsing?

My best friend and I promised we'd stay flatmates after college. But she got into a tier-1 firm and already has this new circle of 'high-package' friends. When I texted her about failing my operating systems midterm, she replied after two days with just a 'that sucks, study hard.' I'm grieving the girl who used to sit on the hostel stairs with me till 3 AM sharing one plate of maggi. It feels like college snatched my soulmate and replaced her with a corporate stranger, and I'm left here with my 6.5 CGPA completely alone.

I look at my old school certificates and I honestly don't know who that kid was. I used to be the state board topper, the one everyone expected big things from. Now, I'm sitting in my hostel room with three backlogs, an empty IDE, and zero energy to even attend the labs. I am mourning the loss of my own brain, my drive, my everything. I ruined my parents' savings and I don't even recognize the hollow, exhausted person staring back at me in the mirror.

My dad hasn't spoken a single warm word to me since the placement results came out and he found out my package is only 4 LPA while our neighbor's kid got 18. He just calls to ask about the education loan installments. I miss my dad—the one who used to buy me ice cream when I was stressed about 10th boards. That dad is dead, and this new guy only cares about ROI. I am grieving a relationship that’s still alive but completely hollowed out by money.

She told me her parents are looking for guys in her community with high packages, and she can't fight them anymore. We've been together since our first-year induction day, and now she’s just deleting our pictures because 'it makes moving on easier.' I have my final year project viva tomorrow and my group partners are furious because I haven't contributed. I'm sitting in the library bathroom stalls weeping because how can a four-year love story just dissolve into community matches and package comparisons?

She got placed in a Tier-1 firm in Bangalore while I got rejected in the final round of the same company. Two days later, she broke up with me saying our 'career trajectories don't match anymore' and blocked me everywhere. I can't even focus on my upcoming OS lab or write a single line of code without seeing her name. How do I just delete four years of shared college dreams while my parents are constantly asking why I didn't get the 12 LPA package she got?

My ex and I used to study for every single midterm together in the library, and now walking past those tables makes me physically sick. He's already moving on, posting stories with his new project group, and I'm sitting here with two backlogs and a failing CGPA, drowning in his absence. I feel like a ghost watching everyone else succeed and love, while I'm completely stuck in the ruins of what we had.

We broke up right before the campus placements started because he said I was 'too anxious' and my stress was dragging him down. Now I have to sit in the same placement PPTs, pretending I'm fine, while my chest literally aches from the rejection. I messed up my DBMS interview today because I kept remembering how he used to mock-test me; I hate that his absence still has this much power over my career.

Three years of late-night coding sessions, building our final year project together, and she just walked away after a stupid fight about our post-grad plans. Every line of our repository has her commits, and I can't even look at the terminal without sobbing. My parents keep calling about the TCS interview tomorrow, but I honestly don't care about the job or the money if she's not there to share it with me.

I saw him at the college fest yesterday holding hands with someone from the junior batch, just three weeks after telling me he needed 'space' to focus on his GATE prep. I spent the entire night crying in the hostel washroom while my roommates were celebrating their semester results. I feel so incredibly stupid for pausing my entire life and neglecting my own studies for someone who replaced me like I was a buggy line of code.
